## Disclaimer

This draft is AI-assisted and requires human review before publishing. Conditions, access rules, weather, and route safety can change.

tips.content: Check weather separately for mountain and lowland sections in Test Region. Conditions can change quickly on scenic roads.
Refuel before remote or mountain sections and do not wait for reserve range.
Keep the GPX offline and check local conditions before starting. This draft still requires human review.
